deliverables: three static key-pose PNGs per concept

productionStages.framePolicy: Plan 12 or more drawn cels for complete loops or activity sequences; a brief blink can use fewer closing cels within its longer idle cycle. Do not slow a blink just to fill a count.

deliverables: all cels inspected in order and as a loop
speech against audible playback including pauses and barge-in
one family enabled through a reversible asset mapping
rollback on missing or unapproved layers
productionStages.retirementCondition: Retire old assets only after all mapped states have approved replacements.

runtimeConstraints.timingStatus: Concept timings are proposals; faster timings require deliberate tested renderer/policy changes.
runtimeConstraints.speechClock: Preserve audible playback clock, aligned viseme cues and silence-to-rest.
runtimeConstraints.activityManifest: Existing v6 validates nine activity IDs and 12 entrance/loop/exit frames; version any incompatible structure.
runtimeConstraints.fullDuplex: Barge-in stops old playback/mouth activity and returns to listening; it must not leave a speaking mouth running.
